findings.title: Dubai Government Human Resources Department launches "Government Chief Talent Officer Programme" (G-CTO)
findings.summary: DGHR has launched the G-CTO programme to develop government talent leaders and equip them to drive workforce transformation across Dubai government entities, with a particular focus on readiness for AI-era work. The first cohort features 30 participants from 21 government entities and runs over eight months, combining specialised learning sessions, applied projects and executive coaching. While framed as an HR/talent initiative, the programme is directly relevant to CX leadership pipelines, since it is explicitly designed to prepare government leaders to navigate AI-driven workforce and service transformation, a precursor to the citizen-facing service improvements MECSC members track.

findings.title: Dubai Municipality launches "Account Manager" initiative for strategic customers
findings.summary: Dubai Municipality has introduced a dedicated Account Manager model for key customer segments, individuals, food traders, real estate developers, contractors and engineering consultants, moving away from a traditional transactional service model towards proactive, relationship-based support. Account Managers are tasked with responding to enquiries and following up on transactions within one working day, coordinating directly across departments, and monitoring interactions through smart systems with monthly reporting for continuous improvement. Manal Bin Yaroof, director of the Customer Happiness Department, framed the initiative as reinforcing Dubai's positioning as a global city built around customer-centred government services.

findings.title: MOHRE adds Tabby instalment option for ministry fees and fines
findings.summary: The UAE's Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation has launched a buy-now-pay-later payment option via Tabby, letting individuals and businesses split ministry service fee payments into monthly instalments. The ministry frames the move as improving customer experience through greater financial flexibility, adding MOHRE to a growing list of federal entities, including ICP (up to Dhs20,000 spread over 3–12 months) and the Ministry of Finance, rolling out instalment-based digital payment options as part of the UAE's wider digital government transformation agenda.

findings.title: Inception42 (G42) targets Q3 2026 for national agentic AI rollout across UAE government
findings.summary: Abu Dhabi's Inception42, the sovereign agentic AI company owned by G42, plans to begin deploying agentic AI systems across UAE federal government administration by Q3 2026, with CEO Ashish Koshy targeting automation of 50% of federal government operations within two years. Built on the Catalyst platform in partnership with Microsoft, the deployment lets AI agents run inside familiar tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, with a "command centre" for human oversight of agent performance. While government-operations-focused rather than purely CX, this is directly relevant to MECSC members tracking the pace and governance model of large-scale agentic AI adoption that will eventually touch citizen and resident-facing services region-wide.

findings.title: Abu Dhabi's Department of Government Enablement launches AI-powered Policy Development Programme
findings.summary: DGE has launched an executive AI-powered Policy Development Programme for senior Abu Dhabi government leaders, developed with the Lee Kuan Yew School of Public Policy, aimed at strengthening evidence-based, technology-enabled governance. The programme includes an intensive Singapore learning module covering impact assessment, behavioural insights, policy communication and the application of artificial intelligence in government transformation. Relevance for MECSC members is indirect but notable: it signals continued Gulf government investment in building leadership capability to apply AI responsibly to citizen-facing policy and service design, ahead of down-stream contact-centre and digital-service rollouts.

findings.title: AethexAI launches with $3m pre-seed to build enterprise voice AI for Africa and the Middle East
findings.summary: AethexAI emerged from stealth with a $3 million pre-seed round, led by 4DX Ventures with participation from Enza Capital, Dorm Room Fund, Mojo Ventures and 26 Fund, to scale its enterprise voice AI platform across Africa and the Middle East. The platform is powered by Kora 1, a proprietary family of voice models trained on licensed datasets from call centres, radio networks and content platforms, positioning the company squarely in the contact-centre and CX voice-AI space that MECSC members are evaluating for bilingual (Arabic/English) deployments. Founders Mariama Diallo and Ayooluwa Odemuyiwa cited performance gaps in existing voice AI as the founding motivation.

findings.title: Wasl launches "The Wasl Edit" at Wasl Vita, spotlighting UAE-based brands
findings.summary: Dubai developer Wasl has launched The Wasl Edit, a month-long shopping and lifestyle activation at Wasl Vita running throughout August, featuring a curated line-up of UAE-based brands and emerging local vendors alongside dining concepts and family entertainment. The initiative gives homegrown brands a retail platform while positioning Wasl Vita as an evening destination for shopping, discovery and entertainment, a light-touch example of experience-led programming rather than new construction. See mecsr-weekly-intel-report for any related property/development tracking on Wasl Vita or comparable UAE mixed-use destinations.

findings.title: Aventura Mall
findings.summary: Opening pushed from August to October 2026 as regional supply-chain disruption tied to the conflict delays fit-out; Mabanee's Hilton Kuwait Mangaf resort also slips from September to December 2026. The developer's flagship Avenues mall, by contrast, held 98% occupancy with footfall ticking up.

findings.title: Hala Summer Shopping Festival
findings.summary: Month-long (1–31 Aug 2026) shopping and dining activation spanning Place Vendôme, Doha Festival City, Mall of Qatar, Villaggio, City Center, Landmark, Doha Mall, West Walk, Gewan, Hyatt Plaza and Al Hazm, offering set menus and retail promotions across Qatar's malls.

findings.title: Mabanee
findings.summary: Q2 2026 net profit fell 8% YoY to KD15.5m ($50.5m) as regional conflict hit hospitality demand; revenue slipped 6% to KD32.2m. Mall gross profit was essentially flat (-1.7%) while hospitality gross profit dropped 78%. H1 net profit fell 36% to KD32.4m, though the comparison is distorted by a KD21.6m one-off land-sale gain in H1 2025. Sico Research kept Mabanee as a regional top pick, citing resilience in mall operations and upside from its Saudi expansion (Riyadh and Khobar malls).

findings.title: Jabal Omar Development Company
findings.summary: Q2 2026 revenue rose 43% YoY to SAR715m ($191m) on stronger Hajj-season hotel performance and the commercial-centres (malls) segment, which grew 6% on a 10% rise in occupied leasing area. The company swung to a SAR158m Q2 profit from a year-ago loss; H1 top line rose 16% to SAR1.5bn, though H1 net profit fell 70% to SAR275m against a prior-year comparison boosted by land-sale gains. CEO Saleh Al-Habdan said management is targeting domestic demand as the regional conflict weighed on international tourist arrivals, and flagged the Kingdom's new non-Saudi property-ownership rules as expanding the potential investor base.

findings.title: Al Othaim Investment (Othaim Holding)
findings.summary: Othaim Holding Company acquired a 20% stake in Alpha Capital, a Shariah-compliant boutique investment firm, becoming a strategic partner as part of a shared vision to grow Alpha Capital's regional footprint and explore new investment opportunities.

findings.title: Aldar Properties
findings.summary: H1 2026 net profit after tax rose 18% YoY to AED4.9bn ($1.33bn); EPS up 17% to AED0.53. Development sales of AED12.1bn reflected a measured approach to new UAE launches amid market conditions; backlog stood at AED71.6bn. In July, Aldar unveiled Marsa Al Saadiyat (AED100bn GDV, AED60bn of which Aldar will develop) and announced Yas Point, an AED6bn mixed-use waterfront community on Yas Island, both signal further retail/mixed-use pipeline for the directory to track.
